candidates.name: SoAzKo
candidates.romanization_status: Exact Latin spelling printed on official card; Japanese alias is a phonetic reading aid.

primary_evidence.inspection: Original rendered YouTube player/frame and original-stream audio inspected via local unprompted ASR
primary_evidence.supports: Official original tournament player frame at9:29–9:32 explicitly prints AZKi / ときのそら / 博衣こより under チームピュア. Unprompted local faster-whisper small transcription of the original audio at9:29.84–9:34.54 gives 私たちのチームは、ソアッコーっていう名前…, followed by 3人でね; AZKi at9:48.50–9:52.50 says ソアッコー3人で練習たくさんしてきましたので.
